subject: Audit & Access Logs: export prioritization, SLAs, and staging window
messages:
From: AuditOps <auditops@alphahealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Export window & priorities for audit/access logs

Hi Irene,

Quick question from the security team at AlphaHealth: we need to plan a scheduled export of our tenant audit and access logs for a compliance review in mid‑December. Two asks:

1) Can you confirm the shortest practical time window we can request for a full export (snapshot) versus incremental exports? We have a large volume of events and want the fastest possible handoff.
2) Which data slices you can prioritise for transfer (e.g., auth events, API keys, admin console activity, configuration changes) — and whether those can be delivered ahead of the rest?

Also: what SLA can Redwood provide for delivering the export files once the request is accepted (business days / guaranteed window)? We may need a staging export earlier for a pre‑audit.

If helpful, I can attach a minimal manifest of the date ranges we care about — looking for a rough timeline so we can coordinate our internal reviewers.

Thanks,
Carmen Vega
Security Operations Manager
AlphaHealth
Attachment: (none yet)
From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: AuditOps <auditops@alphahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Export window & priorities for audit/access logs

Hi Carmen — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer up front: we can do both incremental and full snapshot exports; prioritized slices can be staged and delivered ahead of the full bundle. Below is a proposed approach and an initial timeline.

High level
- Incremental exports: practical cadence is hourly or daily; typical handoff time for an incremental batch is within 3 business hours once the export job starts.
- Full snapshot: depends on retention window and total event count; for tenants at your size a snapshot typically completes within 24–48 hours from export start.
- Prioritization: we can stage and deliver high‑priority categories (auth events, admin console activity, and policy/role changes) first as separate files.

Proposed delivery plan for compliance review (suggested)
1) Pre‑audit staging (requested): we deliver a preceding incremental export of the last 7 days focused on high‑priority event types — target turnaround: 6–8 business hours after acceptance.
2) Full historical snapshot: run a single export for the full requested range; estimated completion 24–48 hours depending on total events and whether you request full raw events vs. indexed summaries.
3) Final incremental syncs: daily deltas for any events generated during review period (hourly available on request).

SLA / acceptance window
- We commit to acknowledging export requests within 2 business hours.
- For prioritized staging exports (up to 7 days of recent events), turnaround 6–8 business hours.
- For full snapshots of larger windows, target 24–48 hours; for exceptionally large volumes we’ll provide a completion ETA within the first 4 hours of the job.

Format & contents
- Default formats: newline delimited JSON (ndjson) for raw events, compressed (.gz) bundles.
- We can provide CSV manifests and an export_spec_schema_v2.pdf describing the fields.
- Tombstoning / deleted records: we include a delete marker field (deleted:true) for events removed within the export window; we do not permanently purge records from the export unless explicitly requested as part of an erase operation.

Next steps
- If you can share the exact date ranges (manifest) and which event categories you want prioritized, we’ll schedule the pre‑audit staging window. I’ve cc’d Marissa (account lead) for scheduling and Karthik for any policy/retention edge cases.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachment: export_spec_schema_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, AuditOps <auditops@alphahealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 08:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Export window & priorities for audit/access logs

Carmen — quick technical clarifications from our side to make sure the staged deliverable meets your reviewers' needs: 

1) Incremental vs snapshot content: do you need full event bodies (payloads) for increments, or are indexed summaries (event id, type, timestamp, user) sufficient for your pre‑audit reviewers? Full bodies increase export size substantially.
2) Retention/erase handling: if you require proof of deletion for any records (legal hold/erase), let us know so we can include the tombstone series and a deletion attestations manifest. Note that actual deletion at rest follows our standard erase flow and timelines; exports include tombstone markers but do not substitute for erase certifications unless separately requested.
3) Transfer method: preferred transport? We can push to your S3 bucket (pre‑signed URLs), share a Drive folder, or use an encrypted SFTP endpoint. For large snapshots S3 + multipart is fastest.

If you confirm (1) payload vs index preference and (3) transfer mechanism, we’ll schedule the pre‑audit export for the 6–8 hour turnaround window Irene described.

—Karthik
Director, Product & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: AuditOps <auditops@alphahealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 15:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Export window & priorities for audit/access logs

Thanks Irene and Karthik — helpful. Answers below:

- For the pre‑audit staging: payloads are preferred for auth events and admin console activity (we need full context). For less‑critical types (system metrics, ephemeral routing events) an indexed summary is fine.
- Transfer: we prefer S3 (we’ll send a pre‑configured bucket + IAM details).
- Deletion attestations: yes, please include tombstone markers and a short deletion_attestation.csv for any records flagged deleted in the requested range. That will satisfy the compliance evidence team.

I’ve attached a short manifest with the date ranges we need for the snapshot and the list of event categories to prioritise. Please confirm estimated start time for the pre‑audit export.

Carmen
